questions.prompt: What is one advantage of growing sugarcane by vegetative propagation?
options: All the plants have the same good qualities as the parent

questions.prompt: Explain why a banana plantation made entirely of clones is at risk from a single disease.
questions.modelAnswer: All the plants are genetically identical, so they have exactly the same resistance or weakness to diseases. If a disease can infect one plant, it can infect them all, and there is no variation that might give some plants resistance. The disease could spread through the whole plantation and destroy it.
rubric: No variation, so none may be resistant
Disease could wipe out the whole crop
questions.explain: Criterion D: variation and food security.
